关键词: Jack W. (Wes) Omohundro appointed as director
主要内容: On January 1, 2016, Theodore Kuster retired from the Board of Directors of Kentucky Bancshares, Inc. (the Registrant) and from the Board of Directors of Kentucky Bank, the Registrant's sole operating subsidiary (the Bank). Both the Registrant and the Bank expressed gratitude for Mr. Kuster's years of service. In response, the Board of Directors of the Registrant appointed Jack W. (Wes) Omohundro as a director to fill the vacancy left by Mr. Kuster's retirement. Mr. Omohundro will be up for election on the Registrant's Board in 2017. He has been appointed to the Audit and Risk Management Committees of the Registrant's Board and will be compensated on a basis similar to that of other members of the Board, as described in the Registrant's Proxy Statement on Schedule 14A filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission on April 17, 2015. Mr. Omohundro has also been appointed to the Board of Directors of the Bank effective January 1, 2016. The Registrant's Chief Financial Officer, Gregory J. Dawson, signed the report on January 6, 2016, in accordance with the Securities Exchange Act of 1934.
